question: Where’s the closest museum forward of Memory Garden, Baltimore, MD in the direction of Cal, Sr.'s Yard, Aberdeen, MD?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.638575 39.300016)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.186327 39.533089)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'museum'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.638575 39.300016)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.638575 39.300016)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

answers.poi_name: Lillie Carroll Jackson Civil Rights Museum

poi.description: Established by Ms. Justine Bonner. Maintained by Ms. Hannah Trent and the Sandtown South Neighborhood Alliance. A mural in this location depicts Ms. Bonner, Ms. Trent, and Ms. Sandra Smith. The mural was painted by local artist Justin Nethercut.
